name: plan_update
description: Update the status of one step in the active plan created by `plan` (running before starting, done when finished, failed/skipped when not completable). Echoes the full updated plan; statuses persist per session.

step.description: 1-based step number to update, as listed by the active plan.

note.description: Optional short note (e.g. failure reason or skip rationale); echoed in the step status, e.g. `(failed, note: ...)`.
